tip.control: the RAM readout in the dive left rail
tip.text: Refills to 5 RAM each turn, raisable to 9 by upgrade. Up to 2 unspent RAM carries into your next turn; past that it is lost.

claims.resolves: BASE_RAM = 5, the per turn RAM budget before any night upgrade.
MAX_RAM = 9, the ceiling a night RAM pick can raise ramPerTurn to.
carryCap is set to 2 for the player's SideEcon when a duel is generated, the cap on unspent RAM carried into the next turn.
